text: June 2026: We cleaned the brick pavers on a Main Beach driveway, side path, patio and rear courtyard with a low-pressure wash, taking the courtyard from grimy and stained to clean and even-toned. We also cleaned the windows inside and out, including tracks and screens.
alt: Before and after of the rear courtyard with palms and drain. Before: Grimy stained pavers in courtyard with palms, drain and wall, box at co in Main Beach
